question: The ‘Rann Utsav’ is organised in which of the following states of India to promote tourism?
solution:
The correct answer is **Gujarat**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Rann Utsav is usually celebrated in the months of December to February.**
 
• It is held every year in the Kutch district of Gujarat. This year it was celebrated in 1st December 2019 to 20th February 2020
 
• Kutch or Rannutsav, a unique manifestation of the varied cultural ethos of the region is known for the ethnic flavor and celebrative zest.
 
• Semi parched Grasslands of the Banni hosts the Utsav.
